question.text: Under the SEBI PPM-audit regime, which of the following AIFs is NOT exempted from the annual PPM audit requirement?

answer.text: Angel Funds with total investments at cost of INR 50 crore
AIFs where each investor commits at least INR 70 crore (USD 10 million equivalent) with a prescribed waiver
A Cat III open-ended hedge fund with total corpus of INR 300 crore and multiple HNI investors below INR 70 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 9.5.2 the PPM-audit exemption applies to (i) Angel Funds (though Angel Funds >= INR 100 crore are mandatorily audited from FY 2025-26), (ii) AIFs where each investor commits INR 70 crore with a prescribed waiver, (iii) Large Value Funds without the need for a waiver. A standard multi-HNI Cat III AIF does not meet any of these thresholds and MUST do the annual PPM audit. The Trap: Option A is eligible (INR 50 crore is below the INR 100 crore trigger for mandatory audit from FY 2025-26). Options B and C are explicit exempted categories. Only Option D has no exemption. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the exemption matrix across tracks. XIX-D focuses on Cat I/II exemptions including the Angel Fund INR 100 crore threshold.
